allow_disabling_hashboards_on_nopic_mine.description: Allows NoPIC miners to continue mining with a damaged hashboard by bypassing the default safety shutdown. Use only if you understand the risks.
allow_disabling_hashboards_on_nopic_mine.title: Hashboard Disabling on NoPIC Miners

allow_missing_voltage_feedback.description: Allows miner to start without voltage feedback from PIC or PSU. Disables voltage verification and short-circuit detection. Use only if you understand the risks.
allow_missing_voltage_feedback.title: Allow missing voltage feedback

cgminer_readonly.description: When enabled, all mutating CGMiner API commands are blocked. This includes pool management (add/remove/replace/enable/disable/switch) and mining control (pause/resume).
cgminer_readonly.title: CGMiner API Read-Only

defrost_temperature_limit_c.description: When defrost temperature is reached, miner will stop heating up the hashboards and proceed to boot up. Recommended value for Immersion and Hydro miners is 10 °C, for air-cooled miners set a temperature that fits your operation. Keep in mind that booting machines that are too cold may affect hardware health.
defrost_temperature_limit_c.title: Defrost Temperature Limit

defrost_timeout_mode.description: Controls how long the hashboard heat-up routine runs. Indefinite means defrost runs until the hashboard is warm. Timed means defrost stops after the Defrost Timeout Duration.
defrost_timeout_mode.title: Defrost Timeout Mode

defrost_timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for the hashboard heat-up routine.
defrost_timeout_s.title: Defrost Timeout Duration

enable_continuous_tuning.description: Keeps tuning the miner continuously after the initial tuning is complete.
enable_continuous_tuning.title: Continuous Tuning

enable_defrost.description: Preheats cold hashboards to allow mining startup in low-temperature conditions.
enable_defrost.title: Defrost Hashboards

fan_maximum_efficiency_mode.description: Runs the miner as cool as possible by controlling fans using both inlet and outlet temperature targets to slightly improve efficiency.
fan_maximum_efficiency_mode.title: Maximum Fan Efficiency Mode

ignore_internal_chip_temperature.description: Disables the automatic pause triggered when an internal chip reaches DANGEROUS temperature. May lead to overheating or hardware damage.
ignore_internal_chip_temperature.title: Override Chip Temperature Safety Check

mdns_enabled.description: When enabled, the miner advertises its web interface and API over mDNS/DNS-SD so it can be discovered on the local network without knowing its IP address. Large miners default to disabled because link-local multicast is flooded to every port on flat farm networks. Small miners default to enabled; a device's live schema reports the default for its platform.
mdns_enabled.title: Advertise over mDNS

min_fan_pwm.description: Minimum fan PWM percentage used when Min Fan PWM Mode is set to Manual.
min_fan_pwm.title: Min Fan PWM

min_fan_pwm_mode.description: Controls how the minimum fan PWM is determined at startup. In Auto mode, the miner runs fan autoconfiguration to find the minimum RPM. In Manual mode, a fixed value from Min Fan PWM is used instead.
min_fan_pwm_mode.title: Min Fan PWM Mode

normal_ramping_time_down_mode.description: Controls the ramp-down time during shutdown or restart. By default, the built-in timing is used. In Custom mode, the Normal Ramping Time Down value is applied.
normal_ramping_time_down_mode.title: Normal Ramp-Down Time Mode

normal_ramping_time_down_s.description: Controls how quickly the miner ramps down frequency. Lower values may increase stress on components and reduce device lifespan. Higher values may be limited during miner shutdown and restart.
normal_ramping_time_down_s.title: Normal Ramping Time Down

normal_ramping_time_up_mode.description: Controls the ramp-up time after boot or restart (not pause/resume). By default, the built-in timing is used. In Custom mode, the Normal Ramping Time Up value is applied.
normal_ramping_time_up_mode.title: Normal Ramp-Up Time Mode

normal_ramping_time_up_s.description: Controls how quickly the miner ramps up after boot or restart (not pause/resume). Lower values may increase stress on components and reduce device lifespan.
normal_ramping_time_up_s.title: Normal Ramping Time Up

overheat_recovery_mode.description: Override the behavior after the miner pauses due to DANGEROUS temperature. By default, automatic resume after cooldown is enabled for air-cooled and immersion miners but disabled for Hydro miners (to protect against damage when cooling water is not flowing).
overheat_recovery_mode.title: Auto-Recovery After Overheating

rambo_mode.description: Rambo mode is a "fault tolerance level". Will ignore some errors in chip and PSU communication.
rambo_mode.title: Rambo Mode

start_cooldown_mode.description: Controls the cooldown that runs before mining starts or resumes. By default the miner waits for the chips to cool down to a pre-defined temperature. Timed mode caps the total wait time. Disabled mode skips the cooldown altogether. Starting with chips too hot can affect hardware health.
start_cooldown_mode.title: Cooldown Before Start Mode

start_cooldown_timeout_s.description: Maximum time the miner spends cooling the chips down before mining starts or resumes.
start_cooldown_timeout_s.title: Cooldown Before Start Timeout

startup_delay_max_s.description: Maximum random delay before mining startup. A random value between 0 and this maximum is chosen each time the miner starts or resumes from pause. Useful for staggering startup across a farm after a power event.
startup_delay_max_s.title: Maximum Startup Delay
